children: The Justin Sun Prize has proposed awarding $1 million each for two research results related to the Riemann hypothesis, for a total of $2 million. According to Foresight News, the results are still awaiting final verification.

The prize focuses on solving mathematical problems and formal verification, and its proposed award is intended to support work connecting mathematics and artificial intelligence. The rewards remain subject to verification and do not mean the proofs have received formal recognition from the academic community.

title: The Justin Sun Prize Proposes $2 Million in Rewards for Two Riemann Hypothesis Studies
